papers.title: An explicit solution for optimal investment problems with autoregressive prices and exponential utility
papers.abstract: We calculate explicitly the optimal strategy for an investor with exponential utility function when the stock price follows an autoregressive Gaussian process. We also calculate its performance and analyse it when the trading horizon tends to infinity. Dependence of asymptotic performance on the autoregression parameter is determined. This provides, to the best of our knowledge, the first instance of a theorem linking directly the memory of the asset price process to the attainable satisfaction level of investors trading in the given asset.

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文是关于金融投资优化的，与有限元代理建模或生物力学植入物设计完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is about financial portfolio optimization and does not address FEA, surrogate modeling, constraints, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究自回归价格过程下的最优投资策略。
summary_zh.method: 利用指数效用函数推导解析最优策略。
summary_zh.result: 得到了策略的显式解，并分析了交易期限趋于无穷时的渐近性能。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，基于理论推导。

summary_en.motivation: To derive an explicit optimal investment strategy for an investor with exponential utility when asset prices follow an autoregressive Gaussian process.
summary_en.method: Analytical derivation using dynamic programming and properties of Gaussian processes to solve the portfolio optimization problem.
summary_en.result: Closed-form expressions for the optimal strategy and asymptotic performance are obtained, linking the memory of the price process to investor satisfaction.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical analysis only, no empirical or numerical validation.

summary_zh.method: 通过实验表征微观结构和力学测试

summary_en.motivation: This study characterizes the microstructure and mechanical properties of hot work tool steel fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Experimental characterization including microscopy and mechanical testing was performed on SLM-processed specimens.
summary_en.result: The relationship between SLM processing parameters and resulting material properties was analyzed.
summary_en.validation: Validation was through experimental mechanical testing and microstructural observation.
